scope: Exploratory follow-up motivated by the completed new40 component results; not a confirmatory or preregistered endpoint.
training: No new training or checkpoint selection; reuse all 12 component 40k development-selected checkpoints
input: Exact existing Gaussian-filtered and resampled absolute-spacing arrays; source geometry and references unchanged
question: Does the effect of retrained first/second intensity-difference representations change with physical sampling distance in the same patients?
statistics: Complete 22-component contrast family, separately at 6 mm and 15 mm and their paired difference; 10000 patient bootstrap replicates, seed 2026111513; all intervals exploratory and unadjusted; three-seed crossed bootstrap as sensitivity only
time_guard: Wait for main absolute-spacing queue. Start all 12 evaluation configurations only with at least 30 minutes remaining. No outcome-based stopping, exclusions, or subset choice.
